opts: Immediately resume high-quality chest compressions for 2 minutes without pausing to check the pulse or analyze the rhythm.
Pause for 30 seconds to carefully palpate the carotid pulse.
Immediately administer 2 mg of IV Atropine bolus.
Disconnect the ECG monitor and evaluate bilateral pupillary reflexes.
qs.ex: بعد الصدمة على طول نرجع لـ CPR لمدة 2 دقيقة، من غير ما نفحص النبض.

qs.q: What is the correct dosing and administration schedule for Epinephrine during adult cardiac arrest?
opts: 0.1 mg IV bolus administered once at the start of resuscitation only.
1 mg IV/IO administered every 3 to 5 minutes.
10 mg IV push administered every 60 seconds until spontaneous circulation returns.
1 mg continuous IV infusion administered over 24 hours via micro-infusion pump.
qs.ex: الـ Epinephrine في الـ arrest: 1 mg IV/IO كل 3–5 دقايق.

qs.q: What is the first-line antiarrhythmic medication and initial bolus dose for refractory VF/pVT after the third defibrillation shock?
opts: Adenosine 6 mg rapid IV push with saline flush.
Diltiazem 20 mg slow IV push over 10 minutes.
Digoxin 0.5 mg IV push diluted in 5% dextrose.
Amiodarone 300 mg IV/IO push bolus (followed by a second dose of 150 mg if needed).
qs.ex: الـ Amiodarone 300 mg بعد الصدمة التالتة، وبعدها 150 mg.

qs.q: A patient in cardiac arrest displays an organized, narrow-complex electrical rhythm at 75 bpm on the monitor, but has NO palpable carotid pulse. The team should:
opts: Identify this as Pulseless Electrical Activity (PEA), withhold electrical shock, continue high- quality CPR, give Epinephrine 1 mg, and search for 5 H's and 5 T's.
Deliver an immediate 200 J unsynchronized defibrillation shock.
Immediately stop CPR and transfer the patient to the MRI suite.
Administer 300 mg of IV Amiodarone bolus immediately.
qs.ex: رسم منظم ومفيش نبض = PEA. ملوش صدمة، علاجه CPR و epinephrine.

qs.q: Which reversible cause of cardiac arrest is treated with immediate needle thoracostomy decompression?
qs.ex: الـ Tension pneumothorax بيتعالج بـ needle decompression فوراً.

qs.q: What specific pharmacologic antidote is indicated for cardiac arrest secondary to Torsades de Pointes or suspected hypomagnesemia?
opts: Calcium Gluconate 10 grams rapid IV push.
Magnesium Sulfate 1 to 2 grams IV/IO diluted and pushed over 1 to 2 minutes.
qs.ex: الـ Torsades أو نقص الماغنسيوم: Magnesium sulfate 1–2 جرام.

qs.q: What is the clinical significance of a sudden, abrupt spike in End-Tidal CO2 (EtCO2) to 35-40 mmHg during continuous capnography in CPR?
opts: It indicates that the endotracheal tube has become dislodged into the esophagus.
It is the earliest objective indicator of Return of Spontaneous Circulation (ROSC).
It signals the immediate onset of irreversible cerebral brain death.
It reflects sudden catastrophic rupture of the alveolar capillaries.
qs.ex: ارتفاع الـ EtCO2 فجأة لـ 35–40 أثناء الـ CPR أول علامة إن النبض رجع (ROSC).

qs.q: What is the recommended target temperature range for Targeted Temperature Management (TTM) in comatose adults post-cardiac arrest?
opts: Maintained constantly between 32°C and 36°C for at least 24 hours.
Maintained at 25°C using total body immersion in ice water.
qs.ex: الـ TTM بعد الـ arrest: من 32 لـ 36 درجة لمدة 24 ساعة على الأقل.

qs.q: How is Unstable Angina (UA) fundamentally distinguished from Non- ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction (NSTEMI)?
opts: Unstable angina always displays persistent ST-segment elevations >=3 mm.
NSTEMI chest pain only occurs following strenuous physical exertion.
Unstable angina is fatal within 5 minutes without surgical intervention.
Cardiac biomarkers (Troponin I and T) remain negative in Unstable Angina, whereas they are elevated in NSTEMI indicating myocardial necrosis.
qs.ex: الـ Unstable angina الـ Troponin بتاعها سلبي، والـ NSTEMI إيجابي.

qs.q: ST-segment elevation in leads II, III, and aVF indicates an acute myocardial infarction localized to which anatomical myocardial wall, and involving which culprit vessel?
opts: Inferior myocardial wall, typically caused by acute occlusion of the Right Coronary Artery (RCA).
Anterior myocardial wall, caused by acute occlusion of the Left Anterior Descending (LAD).
Lateral myocardial wall, caused by acute occlusion of the Left Circumflex (LCx).
Septal myocardial wall, caused by acute occlusion of the Left Main Coronary Artery.
qs.ex: ST elevation في II و III و aVF = Inferior MI، وغالباً من انسداد الـ RCA.

qs.q: What is the international benchmark for 'Door-to-Balloon' time for primary Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI) in acute STEMI?
opts: Less than 30 minutes from emergency department admission.
Less than 90 minutes from patient arrival at a PCI-capable facility.
Less than 180 minutes following coronary angiography.
Within 12 to 24 hours after symptom onset.
qs.ex: الـ Door-to-balloon أقل من 90 دقيقة.

qs.q: When is supplemental oxygen administration clinically indicated in an acute coronary syndrome patient under modern AHA guidelines?
opts: Routinely to all chest pain patients at 15 L/min via non-rebreather mask regardless of SpO2.
Only when arterial PaCO2 drops below 20 mmHg.
Never, because oxygen therapy is strictly toxic to cardiac myocytes in all settings.
Only when oxygen saturation (SpO2) is below 94%, or the patient displays respiratory distress, cyanosis, or heart failure.
qs.ex: الأكسجين في الـ ACS بيتدّي بس لو الـ SpO2 أقل من 94%، أو فيه ضيق تنفس.

qs.q: What is the recommended dose and route for Aspirin during the immediate initial management of suspected acute myocardial infarction?
opts: 162 to 325 mg non-enteric coated tablet CHEWED immediately.
81 mg enteric-coated tablet swallowed whole with 500 mL water.
1000 mg IV infusion administered over 2 hours.
325 mg rectal suppository administered after cardiac catheterization.
qs.ex: الـ Aspirin من 162 لـ 325 mg، ممضوغ، على طول.

qs.q: Sublingual Nitroglycerin administration is ABSOLUTELY CONTRAINDICATED in which of the following clinical scenarios?
opts: Hypertensive crisis with pulmonary congestion and SpO2 96%.
Anterior STEMI with heart rate 85 bpm and blood pressure 150/90 mmHg.
Systolic Blood Pressure <90 mmHg, Right Ventricular Infarction, and recent use of Sildenafil (within 24 hours) or Tadalafil (within 48 hours).
Persistent retrosternal chest pain in a patient with a history of penicillin allergy.
qs.ex: الـ Nitroglycerin ممنوع لو الضغط أقل من 90، أو فيه RV infarction، أو المريض واخد sildenafil قريب.

qs.q: Why is a patient with an acute Right Ventricular (RV) Infarction critically dependent on adequate preload?
opts: Because the right ventricle relies on anaerobic glycolysis requiring hypervolemia.
Because the stunned, stiff right ventricle cannot pump forward without elevated filling pressures; venodilators (nitrates/morphine) cause acute hemodynamic collapse.
Because pulmonary capillary wedge pressure must exceed 40 mmHg to prevent valve regurgitation.
Because RV infarction causes immediate renal artery stenosis requiring high pressure.
qs.ex: البطين اليمين المتأذي مش قادر يضخ لوحده، فمحتاج preload (سوائل) يدفع الدم.

qs.q: What is the emergency positioning priority for a patient presenting with acute decompensated heart failure and flash pulmonary edema?
opts: Strict High Fowler's position with legs dangling over the side of the bed.
Flat supine position with the feet elevated 30 degrees (Trendelenburg).
Prone position to promote dorsal lung recruitment.
qs.ex: الـ pulmonary edema: High Fowler's والرجلين متدلية.

qs.q: What is the hallmark symptom and classic physical expectoration seen in fulminant acute pulmonary edema?
opts: Thick, tenacious foul-smelling green purulent sputum with high fever.
Dry non-productive cough with unilateral localized expiratory wheeze.
Painful hemoptysis with dark brown 'currant-jelly' gelatinous mucus.
Severe orthopnea, air hunger, bilateral diffuse crackles, and expectoration of pink, frothy sputum.
qs.ex: الـ pulmonary edema: ضيق تنفس شديد، و crackles على الناحيتين، وبلغم وردي رغوي.

qs.q: How does Non-Invasive Positive Pressure Ventilation (CPAP / BiPAP) provide rapid therapeutic relief in cardiogenic pulmonary edema?
opts: It selectively constricts the pulmonary capillary bed to eliminate blood flow.
It generates positive airway pressure that physically pushes transudate fluid out of the alveoli, improves gas exchange, and reduces left ventricular afterload.
It neutralizes systemic lactic acidosis by delivering concentrated helium gas.
It replaces the need for any subsequent diuretic or vasodilator therapy.
qs.ex: الـ CPAP/BiPAP بيعمل ضغط إيجابي يرجّع السوائل من الـ alveoli، وبيقلل الـ preload.

qs.q: What is the physiological hallmark of a patient with a modern continuous-flow Ventricular Assist Device (LVAD)?
opts: The patient maintains a bounding, hyperdynamic radial pulse of 180 bpm at all times.
The patient requires mechanical chest compressions continuously during sleep.
The patient typically has NO PALPABLE PERIPHERAL PULSE and standard automated oscillometric blood pressure cuffs fail to register a reading.
The patient has completely absent heart sounds and absent breath sounds bilaterally.
qs.ex: مريض الـ LVAD غالباً مفيش عنده نبض ممكن يتحس، لأن الدم بيتدفق باستمرار.

qs.q: How must blood pressure be measured accurately in a patient with a continuous- flow LVAD?
opts: Using an automated oscillometric digital blood pressure cuff set to pediatric mode.
By measuring venous pressure via a peripheral 22G intravenous cannula.
Blood pressure cannot and should never be measured in any LVAD recipient.
Using a manual sphygmomanometer cuff and a vascular Doppler probe placed over the radial or brachial artery to determine the Doppler MAP.
qs.ex: ضغط مريض الـ LVAD بيتقاس بجهاز يدوي و Doppler.

qs.q: What is the recommended target Doppler Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) range in an LVAD patient?
qs.ex: الـ MAP المستهدف في الـ LVAD من 70 لـ 90.

qs.q: What is the fundamental safety rule regarding external electrical defibrillation in a patient with an implanted LVAD?
opts: Defibrillation is strictly contraindicated because electrical current permanently detonates the lithium controller batteries.
Defibrillation must be delivered at 1000 Joules monophasic through the patient's lumbar spine.
Defibrillation is safe and indicated for VF/pVT, but electrode pads must NEVER be placed directly over the implanted titanium pump housing in the left subcostal area.
The LVAD must be surgically removed by an on-call surgeon before any defibrillation attempt.
qs.ex: الـ defibrillation آمن ومطلوب في الـ VF/pVT مع الـ LVAD.

qs.q: Why are standard external chest compressions (CPR) controversial and approached cautiously in an unresponsive LVAD patient?
opts: Compressions permanently reverse the electrical polarity of the home wall power outlet.
Compressions carry a high risk of dislodging the inflow cannula from the LV apex or tearing the aortic anastomosis, resulting in catastrophic fatal hemorrhage.
Compressions induce immediate bilateral pulmonary atelectasis within 10 seconds.
Compressions have no effect because the ribs are replaced by titanium mesh during LVAD surgery.
qs.ex: الـ CPR في مريض الـ LVAD خطر، لأنه ممكن يحرّك الـ cannula.

qs.q: What are the three components of the classic, pathognomonic Beck's Triad seen in Cardiac Tamponade?
opts: Severe hypertension, bradycardia, and irregular respiratory pattern (Cushing's Triad).
Abdominal pain, palpable pulsatile mass, and fever with chills.
Chest pain, pericardial friction rub, and widespread ST depression.
Hypotension (with narrow pulse pressure), Jugular Venous Distension (elevated CVP), and Muffled (distant) Heart Sounds.
qs.ex: الـ Beck's triad: ضغط واطي، و JVD، وأصوات قلب مكتومة.

qs.q: What is 'Pulsus Paradoxus', a key clinical hallmark of acute cardiac tamponade?
opts: An exaggerated drop in Systolic Blood Pressure of greater than 10 mmHg during normal inspiration.
An elevation of systolic blood pressure by 20 mmHg during coughing.
An alternating strong and weak peripheral pulse with a regular heart rate.
A complete absence of blood pressure during voluntary breath holding.
qs.ex: الـ Pulsus paradoxus = الضغط الانقباضي بيقل أكتر من 10 mmHg مع الشهيق.

qs.q: What pathognomonic electrocardiographic finding is produced by the physical swinging of the heart within a massive pericardial effusion?
opts: Continuous delta waves characteristic of Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome.
Electrical Alternans (alternating beat-to-beat amplitude and axis of the QRS complexes).
Prominent U waves following the T wave in precordial leads.
Widespread reciprocal ST-segment elevation in all 12 leads.
qs.ex: الـ Electrical alternans: ارتفاع الموجات بيتغير كل نبضة، بسبب إن القلب بيتمرجح في السائل.

qs.q: How is Cardiac Tamponade fundamentally distinguished from Tension Pneumothorax during emergency bedside assessment?
opts: In cardiac tamponade, the systolic blood pressure is always extremely elevated above 220 mmHg.
Tension pneumothorax produces muffled heart sounds and electrical alternans.
In cardiac tamponade, breath sounds are bilaterally EQUAL and CLEAR, and the trachea is MIDLINE; in tension pneumothorax, breath sounds are absent unilaterally with tracheal deviation.
Cardiac tamponade causes immediate massive purulent productive sputum.
qs.ex: في الـ tamponade أصوات التنفس متساوية في الناحيتين. في الـ tension pneumothorax بتختفي في ناحية.

qs.q: What is the correct anatomical approach and needle angulation for emergency subxiphoid pericardiocentesis?
opts: Inserted between the xiphoid process and left costal margin at a 45-degree angle to the skin, directed superiorly and posteriorly toward the left shoulder.
Inserted perpendicular (90 degrees) directly through the center of the sternal manubrium.
Inserted horizontally through the right 8th intercostal space midaxillary line aiming toward the spine.
Inserted inferiorly through the umbilicus aimed toward the pubic symphysis.
qs.ex: الـ pericardiocentesis: الإبرة بين الـ xiphoid والـ costal margin الشمال، ناحية الكتف الشمال.

qs.q: During emergency pericardiocentesis under continuous ECG limb-lead monitoring, what ECG change signals that the needle has made direct contact with the ventricular myocardium?
opts: Sudden disappearance of the P wave followed by deep Q waves.
A gradual increase in the PR interval progressing to complete AV block.
Acute ST-segment elevation (injury current), requiring immediate slight withdrawal of the needle.
Total electrical silence (asystole) on all monitoring leads.
qs.ex: ظهور ST elevation معناه إن الإبرة لمست عضلة القلب، فنسحبها شوية.

qs.q: Which hemodynamic profile is diagnostic of Cardiogenic Shock in a patient following an extensive acute anterior myocardial infarction?
opts: Systolic BP >180 mmHg, elevated Cardiac Index (>4.5 L/min/m²), and PCWP <8 mmHg.
Normal blood pressure, normal cardiac output, and absent central venous pressure.
Profound hypotension with elevated systemic vascular resistance and PCWP <5 mmHg.
Persistent Systolic BP <90 mmHg, reduced Cardiac Index (<2.2 L/min/m²), and elevated Pulmonary Capillary Wedge Pressure (PCWP >18 mmHg).
qs.ex: الـ Cardiogenic shock: الضغط الانقباضي أقل من 90، و cardiac index أقل من 2.2، و wedge pressure عالي.

qs.q: Why is aggressive, high-volume IV crystalloid fluid resuscitation contraindicated in primary Cardiogenic Shock?
opts: Because crystalloid fluids cause immediate severe systemic alkalosis.
Because the failing left ventricle cannot pump forward; volume loading rapidly increases hydrostatic pressure and precipitates lethal pulmonary edema.
Because IV fluids immediately dissolve all therapeutic coronary stents.
Because crystalloids stimulate immediate hypercalcemic crisis.
qs.ex: البطين الفاشل مش قادر يضخ، فالسوائل الكتير بتعمل pulmonary edema.

qs.q: What hemodynamic criteria define a Hypertensive Crisis according to standard critical care guidelines?
opts: Acute, severe elevation of blood pressure with Systolic BP >180 mmHg and/or Diastolic BP >120 mmHg.
Systolic BP between 130 and 139 mmHg with Diastolic BP between 80 and 89 mmHg.
Diastolic BP >90 mmHg measured on three separate outpatient clinical visits.
A sudden drop in mean arterial pressure below 50 mmHg during exercise.
qs.ex: الـ Hypertensive crisis: الضغط الانقباضي أعلى من 180 أو الانبساطي أعلى من 120.

qs.q: What is the defining clinical difference between a 'Hypertensive Urgency' and a 'Hypertensive Emergency'?
opts: Hypertensive Emergency only occurs in pregnant patients with pre-existing diabetes.
Hypertensive Urgency requires immediate endotracheal intubation and mechanical ventilation.
Hypertensive Emergency is defined solely by a diastolic pressure exceeding 160 mmHg.
Hypertensive Emergency features acute, life-threatening target organ damage; Hypertensive Urgency features severe BP elevation WITHOUT acute target organ damage.
qs.ex: الـ Emergency فيها أذى حاد في الأعضاء، والـ Urgency مفيهاش.

qs.q: Which of the following clinical findings demonstrates acute target organ damage diagnostic of a Hypertensive Emergency?
opts: Mild chronic bilateral ankle stiffness after waking in the morning.
Hypertensive encephalopathy with papilledema, acute pulmonary edema, acute aortic dissection, or acute renal failure.
Isolated trace proteinuria on a routine outpatient dipstick without symptoms.
Asymptomatic blood pressure of 190/110 mmHg in an ambulatory clinic.
qs.ex: أذى الأعضاء: encephalopathy و papilledema، و pulmonary edema، وفشل كلوي حاد.

qs.q: According to the 'Sacred 25% Rule' in managing Hypertensive Emergencies, what is the maximum recommended reduction in Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) during the first hour?
opts: Reduce MAP immediately by 60% to 70% within the first 10 minutes.
Reduce blood pressure directly to 100/60 mmHg within the first 15 minutes.
Reduce MAP by NO MORE than 20% to 25% within the first hour of parenteral therapy.
Maintain the blood pressure elevated without any reduction for 72 hours.
qs.ex: قاعدة الـ 25%: الـ MAP مينزلش أكتر من 20–25% في أول ساعة.

qs.q: Why is an abrupt, precipitous drop of blood pressure back to normal levels strictly avoided in chronic hypertensive emergencies?
opts: Because sudden blood pressure reduction causes immediate systemic hyperthermia.
Because chronic hypertension shifts cerebral and renal autoregulatory curves to the right; a precipitous drop causes watershed cerebral infarction and acute tubular necrosis.
Because normal blood pressure causes coronary artery spasm and coronary calcification.
Because the peripheral veins collapse permanently if pressure drops below 150 mmHg.
qs.ex: مريض الضغط المزمن الـ autoregulation عنده متعودة على ضغط عالي، فالنزول المفاجئ بيعمل ischemia في المخ والكلى.

qs.q: What is the critical clinical EXCEPTION to the 25% MAP reduction rule, requiring rapid lowering of Systolic Blood Pressure to 100-120 mmHg within 20 minutes?
opts: Acute Ischemic Stroke with planned permissive hypertension.
qs.ex: الاستثناء: الـ Aortic dissection، الضغط الانقباضي بينزل لـ 100–120 خلال 20 دقيقة.

qs.q: Under what clinical conditions is Cyanide Toxicity most likely to occur in a patient receiving Sodium Nitroprusside infusion for a hypertensive crisis?
opts: When the drug is administered as an oral tablet with breakfast.
When the infusion is protected from ambient light by an opaque sleeve.
When the infusion is continued for greater than 72 hours, administered at high rates (>2 mcg/kg/min), or in patients with hepatic or renal impairment.
Only when the patient has a documented allergy to sulfonamides.
qs.ex: تسمم الـ cyanide بيحصل لو الـ Nitroprusside استمر أكتر من 72 ساعة، أو بجرعة عالية، أو مع فشل كلوي أو كبدي.

qs.q: What pathognomonic physical finding and laboratory abnormality characterize Sodium Nitroprusside Cyanide Toxicity?
opts: Fruity acetone breath with profound respiratory alkalosis and hypoglycemia.
Garlic breath odor with elevated serum potassium and thrombocytopenia.
Sweet musty hepatic odor with severe hypocalcemia and hypernatremia.
Distinct odor of bitter almonds on the breath, altered mental status (confusion/agitation), and severe refractory metabolic (lactic) acidosis.
qs.ex: تسمم الـ cyanide: ريحة لوز مر، ولخبطة في الوعي، و metabolic (lactic) acidosis.

qs.q: What is the specific medical management and antidote protocol for confirmed Sodium Nitroprusside Cyanide Toxicity?
opts: Increase the nitroprusside infusion rate and administer high-dose IV potassium.
Administer 50 grams of activated charcoal via nasogastric tube only.
Immediately discontinue the nitroprusside infusion, administer 100% oxygen, and administer Sodium Thiosulfate and/or Hydroxocobalamin (Vitamin B12a).
Administer IV Naloxone and perform immediate hemodialysis.
qs.ex: العلاج: نوقف الـ Nitroprusside فوراً ونديله الـ antidote.

qs.q: What is the anatomical definition of a True Aortic Aneurysm?
opts: A tear restricted exclusively to the vascular endothelium without diameter enlargement.
A permanent localized dilatation of the aorta exceeding 50% of the normal diameter that involves all three layers of the arterial wall (Intima, Media, and Adventitia).
A temporary muscular spasm of the ascending aorta following cold exposure.
A collection of blood confined strictly within the pericardial sac without aortic involvement.
qs.ex: الـ True aneurysm = توسع دائم في الأورطي أكتر من 50% من القطر الطبيعي.

qs.q: How does a 'False Aneurysm' (Pseudoaneurysm) differ anatomically from a True Aortic Aneurysm?
opts: In a pseudoaneurysm, there is a breach in the arterial wall, and the pulsating hematoma is contained only by the adventitia or surrounding perivascular connective tissue.
A pseudoaneurysm contains all three intact arterial wall layers dilated symmetrically.
A pseudoaneurysm is formed exclusively by benign cartilaginous metaplasia.
A pseudoaneurysm only occurs in veins and never involves arterial circulation.
qs.ex: الـ Pseudoaneurysm = قطع في جدار الشريان والدم متجمع بره الطبقات.

qs.q: What is the fundamental underlying pathophysiology of an Aortic Dissection?
opts: Gradual atherosclerotic calcification obliterating the lumen of the femoral artery.
Bacterial endocarditis causing vegetation formation on the tricuspid valve leaflets.
Complete congenital absence of the thoracic and abdominal aorta.
A tear in the tunica intima allows high-pressure systemic blood to enter and separate the layers of the tunica media, creating a false lumen.
qs.ex: الـ Dissection = شق في الـ intima، والدم بيدخل بين طبقات الجدار.

qs.q: What is the classic, pathognomonic symptom description of acute Aortic Dissection?
opts: Mild, dull aching epigastric discomfort that slowly worsens over several weeks.
Sudden onset of excruciating pain described as 'TEARING', 'RIPPING', or 'STABBING' in quality, reaching maximum peak intensity immediately at onset.
Sharp pleuritic pain that is completely relieved when lying perfectly flat.
Painless bilateral lower extremity swelling that improves with elevation.
qs.ex: ألم الـ dissection فجائي وشديد جداً، والمريض بيوصفه كأنه «تمزيق».

qs.q: What critical physical examination finding strongly supports the diagnosis of an acute Aortic Dissection involving the thoracic aorta?
opts: Bilateral equal pupillary light reflex with normal visual acuity.
Presence of bowel sounds in all four abdominal quadrants.
A uniform, strong radial pulse of 72 bpm in both wrists.
A significant difference in Systolic Blood Pressure (>20 mmHg) and pulse amplitude between the right and left upper extremities.
qs.ex: فرق في الضغط الانقباضي أكتر من 20 mmHg بين الدراعين.

qs.q: According to epidemiological data presented in the lecture, what is the annual expansion rate of an untreated Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm (AAA)?
qs.ex: الـ AAA بيكبر حوالي 0.5 سم كل سنة.

qs.q: What are the three components of the classic, pathognomonic clinical triad of a Ruptured Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm (AAA)?
opts: 1. Sudden severe abdominal or back pain; 2. Hypotension / Circulatory Collapse / Shock; 3. Detectable Pulsatile Abdominal Mass.
1. Severe headache; 2. High fever; 3. Nuchal rigidity.
qs.ex: ثلاثية انفجار الـ AAA: ألم شديد في البطن أو الضهر، وضغط واطي، وورم نابض في البطن.

qs.q: What is the pre-hospital mortality rate for patients suffering a Ruptured Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm?
opts: Less than 1% mortality with conservative outpatient bed rest.
100% survival if the patient takes oral aspirin immediately.
Mortality is restricted strictly to patients younger than 20 years.
Approximately 50% of patients die before reaching the hospital, with an additional 24% dying prior to surgical repair.
qs.ex: حوالي 50% من المرضى بيموتوا قبل ما يوصلوا المستشفى.

qs.q: What is the standard clinical threshold size at which surgical intervention is indicated for an Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm?
opts: Aneurysm diameter of 5.5 cm or greater (or rapid growth >0.5 cm in 6 months).
Only when the aneurysm diameter exceeds 12.0 cm.
qs.ex: الجراحة لو القطر 5.5 سم أو أكتر، أو بيكبر أكتر من 0.5 سم في السنة.

qs.q: What is Endovascular Aneurysm Repair (EVAR), and what is its primary advantage over traditional Open Surgical Repair?
opts: A minimally invasive catheter-based procedure placing a stent-graft via the femoral arteries; advantages include 98- 99% full recovery, less operative blood loss, and shorter hospital stay.
A procedure involving total surgical excision of the heart and lungs with heart transplant.
A non-surgical therapy relying solely on external high-intensity focused ultrasound beams.
A procedure that permanently seals the abdominal aorta with synthetic epoxy glue without a graft.
qs.ex: الـ EVAR = دعامة بقسطرة، والتعافي أسرع من الجراحة المفتوحة.

qs.q: What is the primary long-term disadvantage and requirement of Endovascular Aneurysm Repair (EVAR) compared to Open Repair?
opts: EVAR requires continuous lifelong mechanical ventilation in an ICU setting.
EVAR carries a risk of 'endoleaks' (blood leaking around the stent into the aneurysm sac) and graft migration, requiring lifelong periodic radiological surveillance (CT/ultrasound).
EVAR causes permanent total paralysis of both upper extremities.
EVAR requires surgical replacement of the stent graft every 30 days.
qs.ex: عيب الـ EVAR: الـ endoleaks، فالمريض محتاج متابعة بالأشعة طول عمره.

qs.q: In managing acute Aortic Dissection, what is the mandatory pharmacological rule regarding the sequence of IV antihypertensive agents?
opts: Potent vasodilators (Nitroprusside) must be pushed at maximum dose before any beta- blocker.
Positive inotropes (Dobutamine) must be given to increase ventricular ejection velocity.
IV Negative Inotropic Agents (Beta-blockers e.g. Esmolol, Labetalol) MUST be administered FIRST to lower heart rate and reduce shear stress (dP/dt), BEFORE administering vasodilators.
Atropine must be administered to achieve a heart rate of at least 130 bpm.
qs.ex: في الـ dissection الـ Beta-blocker بيتدّي الأول (يقلل النبض)، وبعده الـ vasodilator.

qs.q: What are the therapeutic hemodynamic targets in the initial medical management of acute thoracic Aortic Dissection?
opts: Heart rate >120 bpm and Systolic Blood Pressure >180 mmHg.
Heart rate 90-110 bpm and Mean Arterial Pressure >130 mmHg.
Complete cessation of cardiac activity with cardiopulmonary bypass only.
Heart rate <60 bpm and Systolic Blood Pressure between 100 and 120 mmHg.
qs.ex: الهدف: النبض أقل من 60، والضغط الانقباضي 100–120.

qs.q: What is the primary pathological mechanism underlying the clinical manifestations of Infective Endocarditis?
opts: Severe autoimmune destruction of the coronary sinus endothelial lining.
Microbial infection of heart valves forming friable, infected vegetations that cause valvular destruction (murmurs) and risk systemic septic embolization (stroke/infarction).
Viral demyelination of the phrenic and vagus nerves in the thorax.
Congenital hypertrophy of the pericardial sac compressing coronary blood flow.
qs.ex: الـ Infective endocarditis = ميكروب على الصمامات بيكوّن vegetations ممكن تتكسر وتعمل emboli.

qs.q: What are 'Osler Nodes', a classic peripheral clinical manifestation of Infective Endocarditis?
opts: PAINFUL, tender, erythematous subcutaneous nodules located on the pads of the fingers and toes, caused by immune complex deposition.
Painless hemorrhagic flat macules located exclusively on the palms and soles.
Dark purple linear streaks beneath the fingernail plates resembling wooden splinters.
Small yellowish plaques on the inner canthus of the eyelids.
qs.ex: الـ Osler nodes: عُقد صغيرة بتوجع على أطراف الصوابع.

qs.q: How do 'Janeway Lesions' differ clinically from Osler Nodes in a patient with Infective Endocarditis?
opts: Janeway lesions are extremely painful nodules located exclusively on the earlobes.
Janeway lesions only occur on the buccal mucosa and are relieved by swallowing cold water.
Janeway lesions are identical in pain and histology to Osler nodes without difference.
Janeway lesions are PAINLESS (non-tender) erythematous or hemorrhagic macules located on the palms and soles, caused by septic microemboli.
qs.ex: الـ Janeway lesions مش بتوجع، وبتبقى في الكفوف وبطن الرجل.

qs.q: What are 'Splinter Hemorrhages' observed during physical examination of an infective endocarditis patient?
opts: Circular target lesions on the extensor surfaces of both elbows.
Dark red or brownish linear, longitudinal streaks beneath the fingernail or toenail beds.
Widespread purpuric bullae across the anterior abdominal wall.
Painless ulcerations located on the posterior oropharyngeal wall.
qs.ex: الـ Splinter hemorrhages: خطوط حمرا أو بنية تحت الضوافر.

qs.q: What pathognomonic physical maneuver provides noticeable pain relief to a patient experiencing Acute Pericarditis?
opts: Lying completely flat in the supine position.
Performing the Valsalva maneuver during forced expiration.
Vigorous aerobic walking around the room.
qs.ex: ألم الـ Pericarditis بيخف لما المريض يقعد ويميل لقدام.

qs.q: What is the characteristic physical auscultatory finding of Acute Pericarditis, and how is it clinically distinguished from a pleural friction rub?
opts: A high-pitched, scratchy, grating Pericardial Friction Rub that PERSISTS even when the patient holds their breath.
A low-pitched diastolic rumbling murmur that disappears during breath holding.
Continuous bubbling crackles that only occur during inspiration.
A whistling musical sound that vanishes when the patient sits upright.
qs.ex: الـ Pericardial friction rub: صوت خشن ومستمر حتى لو المريض كتم نفسه. أما الـ pleural rub فبيختفي مع كتم النفس.

qs.q: What electrocardiographic hallmark is pathognomonic of Acute Pericarditis in its early stage?
opts: Localized convex 'tombstone' ST elevation restricted strictly to leads V1 and V2 with reciprocal depression in II, III, aVF.
Widespread, diffuse concave ST-segment elevation with PR-segment depression across almost all limb and precordial leads.
Persistent baseline prolongation of the QT interval exceeding 600 ms with delta waves.
Complete electrical flatline (asystole) with intermittent ventricular escape spikes.
qs.ex: الـ Pericarditis في رسم القلب: ST elevation منتشر ومقعّر، مع PR depression.

qs.q: Which oral presentation is clinically characteristic of Scarlet Fever associated with Group A Streptococcal infection?
opts: Black hairy leukoplakia on the lateral borders of the tongue.
Painful ulcerative aphthous stomatitis across the entire gingiva.
A classic 'Strawberry Tongue' (prominent red papillae protruding through a white or beefy red coating).
Smooth, completely atrophic pale tongue secondary to pernicious anemia.
qs.ex: الـ Scarlet fever: لسان الفراولة (Strawberry tongue).

qs.q: What is the clinical role of administering prophylactic antibiotics prior to dental or invasive procedures in patients with a history of infective endocarditis?
opts: To permanently cure systemic hypertension and eliminate plaque.
To replace the need for routine oral hygiene and brushing.
To induce immediate localized anesthesia of the alveolar nerve.
To prevent transient bacteremia from colonizing damaged endocardial surfaces and prosthetic valves, thereby preventing recurrent endocarditis.
qs.ex: المضاد الحيوي الوقائي قبل الأسنان بيمنع الـ bacteremia إنها تلقح الصمامات المتأذية.

qs.q: What is the critical minimum hourly urine output target monitored via Foley catheter in a critically ill cardiovascular patient?
opts: At least 0.5 mL/kg/hour (or approximately 30 mL/hour in an average adult).
Urine output is irrelevant in hemodynamic cardiovascular monitoring.
qs.ex: كمية البول المطلوبة 0.5 mL/kg/hr على الأقل (حوالي 30 mL في الساعة).

qs.q: Why is immediate, effective pain and anxiety management a vital clinical priority in a patient with acute coronary ischemia?
opts: Pain management is only provided to prevent the patient from crying loudly in the unit.
Opioid analgesics directly neutralize and dissolve all intravascular coronary thrombi.
Pain and anxiety trigger intense sympathetic nervous system stimulation, releasing catecholamines that increase heart rate, blood pressure, and myocardial oxygen demand.
Pain elimination allows the nurse to discontinue continuous cardiac monitoring.
qs.ex: الألم والقلق بيشغّلوا الجهاز السمبثاوي، فالنبض بيزيد واستهلاك القلب للأكسجين بيزيد.

qs.q: What is the mandatory nursing precaution when administering continuous IV vasoactive infusions (such as Norepinephrine or Nitroprusside)?
opts: Administer via rapid gravity free-flow through a 24G hand vein.
Mix vasoactive medications with whole blood units in the same IV tubing.
Stop the infusion abruptly whenever the patient requests oral fluids.
Infuse strictly via a dedicated lumen of a central venous catheter or secure large vein with continuous invasive arterial pressure monitoring, using a dedicated infusion pump.
qs.ex: الـ vasoactive infusions تمشي في lumen لوحدها في central line، وبـ infusion pump.

qs.q: In a patient presenting with acute dyspnea, JVD, bilateral pedal edema, and hepatomegaly secondary to chronic severe COPD, what is the correct diagnostic clinical term?
opts: Left ventricular forward failure secondary to acute mitral stenosis.
Cor Pulmonale (right-sided heart failure secondary to chronic pulmonary hypertension).
Primary aortic valve endocarditis with systemic embolization.
Acute coronary syndrome localized to the left circumflex artery.
qs.ex: Right-sided heart failure بسبب COPD = Cor pulmonale.

qs.q: What comprehensive triage principle must guide the critical care nurse upon initial contact with any patient with a potential cardiovascular emergency?
opts: Rapid systematic ABCDE assessment (Airway, Breathing, Circulation, Disability, Exposure), immediate vital signs, oxygenation if SpO2 <94%, and 12-lead ECG within 10 minutes.
Complete a 50-page family history questionnaire before checking the patient's pulse.
Wait for 4 hours to verify whether chest discomfort resolves spontaneously without intervention.
Administer oral sedatives and discharge the patient directly to outpatient follow-up.
qs.ex: أول حاجة مع أي مريض قلب: تقييم سريع بالـ ABCDE.

qs.q: A patient with chest pain shows ST elevation in leads II, III and aVF. This indicates:
qs.ex: ST elevation في II و III و aVF = Inferior MI (غالباً الـ RCA).

qs.q: Before giving nitroglycerin, the nurse must check:
qs.ex: قبل الـ Nitroglycerin قيس الضغط، ولو الانقباضي أقل من 90 متديهوش.

qs.q: The most specific cardiac biomarker of myocardial injury is:
qs.ex: الـ Troponin I/T هو أكتر marker مخصوص لأذى عضلة القلب.

qs.q: Hypertensive emergency differs from urgency by:
qs.ex: الـ Emergency فيها أذى حاد في الأعضاء، والـ Urgency مفيهاش.

qs.q: Sodium nitroprusside infusion requires (select all):
qs.ex: الـ Nitroprusside: يتغطى من الضوء، ويتراقب الضغط باستمرار، ونخلي بالنا من تسمم الـ cyanide، وبيمشي على infusion pump. عمره ما يتدّي push.

qs.q: Signs of a rupturing abdominal aortic aneurysm include (select all):
qs.ex: علامات انفجار الـ AAA: ألم شديد في الضهر أو البطن، والضغط بيقل، والـ Hct بيقل، وورم نابض في البطن.

qs.q: A patient receiving thrombolytic therapy should be monitored primarily for:
qs.ex: مع الـ thrombolytics أهم حاجة نراقبها النزيف.

qs.q: Decompensated heart failure: the highest priority is to:
opts: Increase cardiac output and organ perfusion
qs.ex: أهم أولوية في الـ decompensated HF: نزوّد الـ cardiac output والدم اللي بيوصل للأعضاء.

qs.q: A patient with which of the following conditions would be identified by the nurse as experiencing a critical illness ?
opts: Post car accident whoseBP:124/74mmHg, P:74b/m, R:18br/min
Acute bronchospasm and whose BP: 100/60 mmHg, P: 124 b/m, R: 32 br/min
qs.ex: مريض عنده bronchospasm حاد، وضغطه 100/60، ونبضه 124، ونفسه 32: ده critical لأن حياته في خطر.

qs.q: You have responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a small bus carrying (6) passengers and a driver and a tractor trailer with a driver. The bus appears to have rolled over and landed on its wheels in the roadway and the tractor trailer is jackknifed in a nearby ditch. Tag the following patients using the TRIAGE code - The driver of the tractor trailer who has been ejected from the vehicle and is trapped under the wheels. His pupils are dilated, and he is pulseless and non breathing ( ...... )
qs.ex: مفيش نبض ولا نفس، والبؤبؤ موسّع: Black (متوفي).

qs.q: You have responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a small bus carrying (6) passengers and a driver and a tractor trailer with a driver. The bus appears to have rolled over and landed on its wheels in the roadway and the tractor trailer is jackknifed in a nearby ditch. An elderly woman who has no apparent injuries, but who is complaining of severe chest pain. She is pale and having obvious respiratory distress. ( ...... )
qs.ex: ست كبيرة عندها ألم صدر شديد، وشاحبة، ونفسها ضيق: Red، أولوية فورية.

qs.q: You have responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a small bus carrying (6) passengers and a driver and a tractor trailer with a driver. The bus appears to have rolled over and landed on its wheels in the roadway and the tractor trailer is jackknifed in a nearby ditch. A young woman who has bilateral lower limb bone injuries with limitation of movement ( ...... )
qs.ex: إصابات عضم في الرجلين ومش قادرة تتحرك، بس مستقرة: Yellow (متأخر).

qs.q: You have responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a small bus carrying (6) passengers and a driver and a tractor trailer with a driver. The bus appears to have rolled over and landed on its wheels in the roadway and the tractor trailer is jackknifed in a nearby ditch. An approximately 15-year-old female who is screaming that her leg hurts
qs.ex: الإجابة حسب البنك Red. حسب START لو مش قادرة تمشي وبتصرّخ من الألم ممكن تبقى yellow، بس اعرف إجابة البنك.

qs.q: Which of the following nursing diagnosis should receive the highest priority
opts: Impaired gas exchange related to increased blood flow
Fluid volume excess related to peripheral vascular disease
Risk for injury related to edema
Altered peripheral tissue perfusion related to venous congestion
qs.ex: حسب البنك: Altered peripheral tissue perfusion.

qs.q: Which of the following is the triage category you would allocate for a 15 year old patient, who arrived at the ED with a small laceration on his forehead He says that he can't move his legs Upon assessment, he had a RR of 20 bt/min, strong pulses, and capillary refill time of less than 2 seconds
qs.ex: جرح صغير بس مش قادر يحرّك رجليه (احتمال إصابة نخاع)، وعلاماته الحيوية مستقرة: Yellow.

qs.q: Triage' system is based upon the principle of treating
qs.ex: الـ Triage: نعالج المرضى حسب الأولوية.

qs.q: You would allocate which of the following triage tags for an elderly woman who is complaining of severe chest pain, pale and having obvious respiratory distress ?
qs.ex: ألم صدر شديد مع شحوب وضيق نفس: Red.

qs.q: Which of the following is a triage tags would be allocated for 75-year-old male with deep cuts to both forearms. Resp. rate 20. Capillary refill greater than 2secs. Alert and oriented
qs.ex: حسب البنك: جروح عميقة في الدراعين، فممكن نزيف وصدمة، فالإجابة Red.

qs.q: Which of the following is a triage tags would be allocated for a 34-year-old man who is unresponsive with exposed brain matters ?
qs.ex: مخ مكشوف ومبيستجيبش: Black (expectant).

qs.q: A patient is admitted to the emergency department with head trauma resulting from an accident. The patient opens both eyes to painful stimuli, makes incomprehensible sounds, and flexes to pain. Using the Glasgow Coma Scale, which score will the nurse document in the ?patient's medical record
qs.ex: بيفتح عينه للألم E2، وأصوات مش مفهومة V2، وبيثني لما يتألم (withdrawal) M4. المجموع 8.

qs.q: A catastrophic disaster has occurred 5 miles from the hospital you are working in. The hospital's disaster plan is activated and the wounded are brought to the hospital. You're helping triage the survivors. One of the wounded is able to walk around and has minor lacerations on the arms, hands, chest, and legs. You would place what color tag on this survivor?
qs.ex: بيمشي وجروحه بسيطة: Green.

qs.q: Which of the following is expected to occur during compensatory stage of shock?
opts: Decreased heart rate and cardiac contractility
Vasodilation to increase systemic vascular resistance
qs.ex: في المرحلة التعويضية للصدمة الجسم بيفرز ADH علشان يحتفظ بالميه.

qs.q: Which of the following interventions should the nurse consider for a patient who has been admitted with cardiogenic shock?
qs.ex: الـ Cardiogenic shock: نبدأ inotropes تقوّي انقباض القلب.

qs.q: Which of the following conditions can lead to obstructive shock?
qs.ex: الـ Cardiac tamponade بيعمل obstructive shock.

qs.q: When assessing a patient who is experiencing anaphylactic shock, which of the following could be an expected manifestation:
qs.ex: الـ Anaphylaxis بيعمل bronchospasm.

qs.q: While assessing chest sounds for a patient with cardiogenic shock, inspiratory crackles were heard, this may be due to:
qs.ex: الـ crackles في الـ cardiogenic shock معناها احتقان في الرئة.

qs.q: Which of the following is an assessment finding that will help the nurse to confirm a diagnosis of neurogenic shock?
qs.ex: الـ Neurogenic shock: نبض بطيء (45) مع ضغط واطي، لأن الـ sympathetic واقف.

qs.q: The first-line of treatment for a patient with anaphylaxis is to administer:
qs.ex: أول علاج للـ anaphylaxis هو Epinephrine. السؤال كان متداخل مع أسئلة تانية في الملف، وفضلنا آخر سؤال بس.

qs.q: In START triage, a patient who can walk is tagged:
qs.ex: اللي بيمشي: Green.

qs.q: The 'golden hour' refers to:
opts: The first hour after admission to ICU
The critical period after injury when definitive care improves survival
qs.ex: الـ Golden hour: الساعة الحرجة بعد الإصابة، لو المريض اتعالج فيها فرصه في النجاة أكبر.

qs.q: Select ALL components of the primary survey.
qs.ex: الـ Primary survey: Airway مع حماية الرقبة، وBreathing، وCirculation ووقف النزيف، وDisability، وExposure.

qs.q: Which type of shock is caused by cardiac tamponade?
qs.ex: الـ Cardiac tamponade: Obstructive shock.

qs.q: An expected finding in the compensatory stage of shock is:
qs.ex: في المرحلة التعويضية: إفراز ADH وسرعة في النبض.

qs.q: A black triage tag indicates:
qs.ex: الـ Black: متوفي أو expectant.

qs.q: The nurse is handling a client with a chest tube. Suddenly, the chest drainage system is accidentally disconnected, what is the most appropriate action for the nurse to take ?
opts: Secure the chest tube using a tape
Place the end of the chest tube in a container of normal sterile saline
Apply an occlusive dressing and notify the physician
qs.ex: لو الـ chest drain اتفصل: نحط طرف الأنبوبة في محلول ملح معقم، علشان يعمل water seal مؤقت ومايدخلش هوا.

qs.q: ...... is a sign of tension Pneumothorax
qs.ex: علامة الـ tension pneumothorax: انحراف القصبة (tracheal deviation).

qs.q: Which intervention should the nurse implement for a male client who has had a left- sided chest tube for six (6) hours and refuses to take deep breaths because it hurts too much?
opts: Medicate the client and have the client take deep breaths
Encourage the client to take shallow breaths to help with the pain
Explain that deep breaths do not have to be taken at this time
Tell the client that if he doesn't take deep breaths, he could die
qs.ex: مريض الـ chest tube رافض ياخد نفس عميق من الألم: نديله مسكّن ونخليه ياخد نفس عميق.

qs.q: The immediate management of tension pneumothorax is
opts: Chest tube placement in 7th intercostal space
Needle thoracentesis in the 2nd intercostal space
A three-sided dressing placement over chest tube
qs.ex: العلاج الفوري للـ tension pneumothorax: needle decompression في المسافة الضلعية التانية.

qs.q: The client is admitted to the emergency department with chest trauma. When assess- ing the client, which signs/ symptoms would the nurse expect to find that support the diagnosis of pneumothorax ?
qs.ex: إصابة الصدر: تمدد الرئة مش متساوي وضيق نفس.

qs.q: ...... causes mediastinal shift and compression of the lungs
qs.ex: الـ Tension pneumothorax بيزق الـ mediastinum وبيضغط على الرئة.

qs.q: The nurse assesses a patient with chest injury who had flail chest for which of the following most distinctive sign ?
qs.ex: الـ Flail chest: حركة الصدر عكسية (paradoxical).

qs.q: Nurse Ruth assessing a patient for tracheal displacement should know that the trachea will deviate toward the:
opts: Contralateral side in a simple pneumothorax
Affected side in a tension pneumothorax
qs.ex: القصبة بتميل بعيد عن الناحية المصابة (contralateral) في الـ hemothorax والـ tension.

qs.q: The above patient is expected to have which of the following types of pneumothorax?
qs.ex: الجرح المفتوح في الصدر (sucking chest wound) معناه Open pneumothorax.

qs.q: A client with a chest injury has suffered flail chest. The nurse assesses the client for which most distinctive sign of flail chest ?
qs.ex: الـ Flail chest: paradoxical movement.

qs.q: A patient was admitted to the ER after a motor vehicle accident with multiple fractured ribs. Respiratory assessment includes signs/symptoms of secondary pneumothorax, which includes which of the following ?
opts: Crackles over lung bases of affected lung
Tracheal deviation toward the affected lung
Sharp pleuritic pain that worsens on inspiration
Increased diaphragmatic excursion on side of rib fractures
qs.ex: كسور الضلوع: ألم حاد بيزيد مع الشهيق.

qs.q: A client reports left-sided chest pain after playing racquetball. The client is hospitalized and diagnosed with left pneumothorax. When assessing the client's left chest area, the nurse expects to identify which finding ?
opts: Absence of breath sounds on auscultation
qs.ex: الـ Pneumothorax: صوت التنفس غايب في الناحية دي.

qs.q: During percussion of the chest wall, hyperresonance suggests which of the following ?
qs.ex: الـ Hyperresonance في الـ percussion: pneumothorax (هوا).

qs.q: What type of pressure or painful stimuli should the nurse avoid in a post-traumatic brain injury patient who has sustained multiple fractures to the face and eyes who is unable to perform a motor command based on a verbal stimulus ?
qs.ex: مع كسور الوش: نتجنب الضغط فوق الحاجب (supraorbital).

qs.q: You have responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a small bus carrying (6) passengers and a driver and a tractor trailer with a driver. The bus appears to have rolled over and landed on its wheels in the roadway and the tractor trailer is jackknifed in a nearby ditch. A middle- aged man who has an open head injury with exposed brain tissue. He is displaying agonal respirations
qs.ex: مخ مكشوف ونفس احتضاري (agonal): Black.

qs.q: While working in the ED, the following four patients arrived at the same time. Indicate how to sort these patients utilizing triage categories:  (1) A patient with a cut wound in the forehead, mild pain in the left leg and can walk  (2) A patient with back & neck cyanosis, with abdominal stab wound & open skull fracture  (3) A patient with left femur open fracture, cold extremities, shallow breathing, & weak pulse  (4) A patient with severe bleeding, is fully conscious with a respiratory rate of 30 br./min
qs.ex: الترتيب: (3) نزيف وصدمة ونفس سطحي، Red أولاً. بعده (4) نزيف شديد بس واعي. بعده (1) بيمشي، Green. وفي الآخر (2) جرح في البطن وكسر جمجمة مفتوح وزرقان، Black. يعني 3, 4, 1, 2.

qs.q: A victim with which of the following conditions would be sorted using a GREEN triage ?
opts: Has abrasions on the whole left posterior leg
qs.ex: سحجات بس في الرجل: Green.

qs.q: A 50-year-old patient, who has bilateral fractured femurs, weak radial pulse and a respiratory rate of 24 br/min will be receive ...... triage tag
qs.ex: كسر في عضمتين الفخذ، ونبض ضعيف (صدمة)، ونفسه 24: Red.

qs.q: While working in the ED, the following four patients arrived at the same time. Indicate how to sort these patients .utilizing triage categories:  (1) A patient is laying supine complaining of inability to feel or move extremities  (2) A patient with open femur fracture that is bleeding profusely  (3) A patient with dislocated shoulder that is controlled by a tourniquet  (4) A patient with open skull fracture and exposed brain matter
qs.ex: الترتيب: (2) كسر فخذ مفتوح بينزف بشدة، Red. بعده (1) مش حاسس بأطرافه، احتمال إصابة نخاع. بعده (3) كتف مخلوع والنزيف متحكم فيه. وفي الآخر (4) مخ مكشوف، Black. يعني 2,1,3,4.

qs.q: A patient is admitted with a left mid-axillary chest wound and extreme dyspnea, tachycardia and hypoxia. There is unequal rise and fall of the chest with absent breath sounds on the left side, and a "sucking" sound on inhalation and exhalation. Chest X-ray shows a pneumothorax. This patient is expected to have which type of pneumothorax?
qs.ex: جرح في الصدر بيطلّع صوت «شفط» مع النفس: Open pneumothorax.

qs.q: Tracheal deviation, absent breath sounds on one side and hypotension suggest:
qs.ex: انحراف القصبة، وغياب الصوت في ناحية، وهبوط الضغط: Tension pneumothorax.

qs.q: Paradoxical chest movement is characteristic of:
qs.ex: الحركة العكسية: Flail chest.

qs.q: Select ALL signs of cardiac tamponade (Beck's triad).
qs.ex: الـ Beck's triad: هبوط الضغط، وانتفاخ أوردة الرقبة، وأصوات القلب مكتومة.

qs.q: Kehr's sign (left shoulder pain) after abdominal trauma suggests:
qs.ex: الـ Kehr's sign (ألم في الكتف الشمال) بعد إصابة البطن: تمزق الطحال.

qs.q: Continuous bubbling in the water-seal chamber of a chest drain indicates:
qs.ex: فقاعات مستمرة في الـ water seal: فيه تسريب هوا.

qs.q: Priority for a patient with suspected spinal cord injury is:
opts: Immobilize the spine while maintaining airway (jaw thrust)
qs.ex: إصابة النخاع: نثبّت العمود الفقري ونفتح الـ airway بالـ jaw thrust.

qs.q: The nurse anticipates that one of the treatment optionsfor a patient diagnosed as having ruptured cerebral aneurysm with manifestations of stroke to be:
qs.ex: الـ ruptured cerebral aneurysm بيتعالج بـ Surgical clipping. والـ thrombolytics ممنوعة لأن الحالة نزيف.

qs.q: A patient who opens his eyes in response to speech, speaks inappropriate words and moves to localize pain site will receive a GCS of:
qs.ex: بيفتح عينه للكلام E3، وكلام غير مناسب V3، وبيحدد مكان الألم M5. المجموع 11.

qs.q: Decorticate posturing refers to abnormal:
opts: Rigid pronation of upper and lower extremities
Flexion of upper extremities and extension of lower extremities
qs.ex: الـ Decorticate: الدراعات مثنية لجوه على الصدر، والرجلين مفرودة. يعني فيه إصابة فوق جذع المخ.

qs.q: An acute stroke patient unable to sign the consent form because of inability to write most probably has:
qs.ex: مش قادر يكتب علشان يمضي: ده Agraphia.

qs.q: To prevent injury in a patient who has hemianopia, the nurse educates the patient to:
qs.ex: الـ Hemianopia معناها إنه فاقد نص مجال الرؤية، فنعلّمه يلف راسه ويمسح جوانب الأوضة بعينه.

qs.q: Signs and symptoms of meningeal irritation include all of the following EXCEPT:
qs.ex: علامات تهيّج السحايا: تيبس الرقبة والصداع، والحساسية من النور، وKernig وBrudzinski. أما الـ Aphasia والـ hemiparesis فعلامات بؤرية زي الجلطة.

qs.q: Which statement regarding psychomotor seizure is TRUE?
opts: They involve acts of random violence
qs.ex: الـ Psychomotor seizure (complex partial) بيبقى فيها سلوك متكرر زي مضغ أو لعب في الهدوم. إجابة مقترحة.

qs.q: Myasthenia gravis is mainly characterized by:
opts: Muscular weakness with exercise, improved with rest
qs.ex: الـ Myasthenia gravis: ضعف العضلات بيزيد مع المجهود وبيتحسن مع الراحة.

qs.q: While inserting a peripheral cannula on the right hand, the patient reaches over with his left hand to remove the noxious stimulus. This response is called:
qs.ex: مدّ إيده التانية علشان يشيل مصدر الألم: ده Localization (M5).

qs.q: You would allocate which Glasgow Coma Scale score for a patient who is in a coma?
qs.ex: الغيبوبة: GCS 8 أو أقل، والاختيار المناسب 6.

qs.q: You would allocate ...... GCS for a patient whose eyes are closed but open to speech, says words that don't make sense, can't obey commands and moves to locate a central stimulus.
qs.ex: عينه بتفتح للكلام E3، وكلام مش مفهوم المعنى V3، وبيحدد الألم M5. المجموع 11.

qs.q: A patient who experienced a transient ischemic attack is at high risk for:
qs.ex: الـ TIA إنذار بإن جلطة المخ (stroke) جاية.

qs.q: When assisting a patient with right-side hemiparesis and dysphagia with eating, it is very important to:
opts: Keep head of bed less than 30 degrees
Prevent aspiration by thinning the liquids
Check for food collected in the right cheek
Extend the patient's neck upward while eating
qs.ex: شلل في الناحية اليمين: الأكل بيتجمع في الخد اليمين ومبيحسش بيه، فلازم نشيك عليه علشان ميشرقش.

qs.q: Hemorrhagic stroke occurs as a result of which of the following?
qs.ex: الـ Hemorrhagic stroke سببه غالباً تمزق aneurysm أو ضغط عالي.

qs.q: Paralysis of the arm and leg on the same side of the body due to stroke or CVA refers to:
qs.ex: شلل الدراع والرجل في نفس الناحية: Hemiplegia.

qs.q: The acute phase of ischemic stroke ranges from:
qs.ex: المرحلة الحادة للـ ischemic stroke من 24 لـ 72 ساعة.

qs.q: When a patient with a stroke finds difficulty with writing, this is called:
qs.ex: صعوبة الكتابة: Agraphia.

qs.q: The clinical manifestations of a patient with hemorrhagic stroke include all of the following EXCEPT:
qs.ex: الـ hemorrhagic stroke بيعمل صداع شديد، وترجيع، وشلل نصفي، والضغط بيبقى عالي مش واطي. فالـ Hypotension هي الاستثناء.

qs.q: In promoting health maintenance for prevention of strokes, the highest risk for the most common type of stroke is present in:
opts: Those who are obese with high dietary fat intake
qs.ex: أعلى خطر لأشهر نوع (ischemic): الضغط العالي والسكر.

qs.q: A thrombus that develops in a cerebral artery does not always cause loss of neurologic function because:
opts: The body can dissolve atherosclerotic plaques as they form
Some brain tissues do not require constant blood supply
Circulation via the circle of Willis may provide blood supply to the affected area
Deficits occur only when major arteries are occluded
qs.ex: دايرة ويليس (circle of Willis) ممكن تعوّض الدم للمنطقة.

qs.q: A patient's facial numbness and inability to speak disappeared while awaiting examination and he requests discharge. Why should the nurse emphasize treatment before leaving?
opts: Symptoms will return and worsen in 24 hours
Transient deficits result from small hemorrhages that clot off
Probably a TIA, which is a sign of progressive cerebrovascular disease
qs.ex: الأعراض اختفت: غالباً TIA، وده إنذار بمرض في أوعية المخ، فلازم يتقيّم.

qs.q: What are characteristics of a stroke caused by intracerebral hemorrhage? (Select all that apply)
opts: Caused by rupture of a vessel
Commonly occurs during or after sleep
Creates a mass that compresses the brain
qs.ex: الـ intracerebral hemorrhage: تمزق في وعاء، والدم بيعمل كتلة بتضغط على المخ، والـ prognosis وحش.

qs.q: Which type of stroke is associated with endocardial disorders, has a rapid onset and is unrelated to activity?
qs.ex: الـ Embolic stroke: مرتبط بأمراض القلب (زي AF)، وبيبدأ فجأة، وملوش علاقة بالمجهود.

qs.q: What primarily determines the neurologic functions affected by a stroke?
opts: The brain area perfused by the affected artery
qs.ex: الوظايف اللي بتتأثر بتتحدد بمنطقة المخ اللي الشريان المسدود بيغذيها.

qs.q: The patient has a lack of comprehension of both verbal and written language. Which communication difficulty does he have?
qs.ex: مش فاهم الكلام المسموع ولا المكتوب: Receptive (Wernicke's) aphasia.

qs.q: A patient with left hemiplegia is admitted. To determine size, location and whether the stroke is ischemic or hemorrhagic, the nurse anticipates:
qs.ex: حسب البنك: الـ MRI بيحدد الحجم والمكان والنوع. (عملياً الـ CT أول حاجة).

qs.q: A carotid endarterectomy is considered for a patient with several TIAs. The nurse explains that it:
opts: Joins a superficial extracranial artery to an intracranial artery
Restores circulation after obstruction of a cerebral artery
Removes an atherosclerotic plaque in the carotid artery to prevent stroke
Opens a stenosis with a balloon and stent
qs.ex: الـ Carotid endarterectomy بيشيل البلاك من الشريان السباتي علشان يمنع الجلطة.

qs.q: The incidence of ischemic stroke in patients with TIAs is reduced with:
qs.ex: الـ Aspirin بجرعة صغيرة يومياً بيقلّل الـ stroke بعد الـ TIA.

qs.q: What is the priority intervention in the ED for the patient with a stroke?
opts: Maintenance of respiratory function with a patent airway and oxygen
qs.ex: الأولوية في الطوارئ: airway مفتوح وأكسجين.

qs.q: A ruptured cerebral aneurysm has been diagnosed. The nurse anticipates which treatment?
qs.ex: الـ Aneurysm المتمزق بيتعالج بالـ clipping أو الـ coiling.

qs.q: During the acute phase of a stroke, which cardiovascular sign is seen as the body attempts to increase cerebral blood flow?
qs.ex: في المرحلة الحادة الضغط بيعلى، علشان الجسم بيحاول يوصّل دم للمخ.

qs.q: During the secondary assessment of a patient with stroke, what should be included? (Select all that apply)
qs.ex: التقييم الثانوي فيه: حركة العين (gaze)، والإحساس، وشلل الوش، والـ proprioception، والحركة.

qs.q: Which nursing intervention is indicated for the patient with hemiplegia?
opts: Sling to immobilize the affected arm
Each joint lower than the proximal joint
Patient performs passive ROM of the affected limb with the unaffected limb
qs.ex: المريض يحرّك الطرف المشلول بالطرف السليم (passive ROM).

qs.q: A right-brain stroke patient has homonymous hemianopsia. Early in care the nurse should:
opts: Place objects on the right side within the field of vision
Place objects on the left side
qs.ex: جلطة في المخ اليمين بتضيّع المجال الشمال، فنحط الحاجات في الناحية اليمين اللي شايفها.

qs.q: Four days after a stroke a patient is to start oral feeding. Before feeding, the nurse should first:
qs.ex: قبل الأكل: نتأكد من الـ gag reflex علشان ميشرقش.

qs.q: What is an appropriate food for a stroke patient with mild dysphagia?
qs.ex: الـ dysphagia الخفيفة: أكل طري متماسك زي البيض المخفوق.

qs.q: A wife asks why her husband with hemorrhagic stroke did not receive tPA. Best response:
opts: He didn't arrive within the timeframe
Not everyone is eligible; has he had surgery?
The medication dissolves clots and could cause more bleeding in his brain
qs.ex: الـ tPA بيدوّب الجلطات، ولو اتدّى في النزيف هيزوّده.

qs.q: What is an appropriate intervention to promote communication in a patient with aphasia?
opts: Structure statements so no verbal response needed
qs.ex: مع الـ aphasia: نتكلم في حاجات يومية مألوفة.

qs.q: A right-hemisphere stroke patient has unilateral neglect. During rehabilitation the nurse should:
opts: Avoid positioning on the affected side
Place objects on the unaffected side
Teach the patient to care consciously for the affected side
Protect the affected side with pillows
qs.ex: الـ unilateral neglect: نعلّمه ياخد باله من الناحية المصابة بقصد.

qs.q: A patient with right-sided hemiplegia: what does the nurse teach the family about behavior changes?
opts: Provide directions verbally in small steps
qs.ex: حسب البنك: نشتت انتباهه بعيد عن ردود الفعل العاطفية غير المناسبة.

qs.q: The nurse helps the family cope with long-term effects of stroke by:
opts: Informing that the patient needs help with all ADLs
Encouraging family therapy or support groups
Helping them understand residual damage to promote problem solving
qs.ex: نساعد الأسرة يفهموا الضرر الدايم علشان يعرفوا يحلّوا المشاكل.

qs.q: Which intervention should the nurse delegate to the LPN when caring for a patient after acute stroke?
opts: Administer ordered antihypertensives and platelet inhibitors
qs.ex: الـ LPN يدّي أدوية الضغط ومضادات الصفائح المكتوبة. أما التقييم والتعليم فشغل الـ RN.

qs.q: The most common arrhythmia associated with stroke is:
qs.ex: أشهر arrhythmia مع الـ stroke هي Atrial fibrillation.

qs.q: What is the primary feature of a coma?
opts: Prolonged unconsciousness and failure to respond to stimuli
Loss of motor function in one side of the body
qs.ex: الغيبوبة: فقدان وعي طويل ومفيش استجابة للمؤثرات.

qs.q: Which of the following is a systemic cause of coma?
qs.ex: سبب جهازي (مش من المخ نفسه): Hepatic encephalopathy.

qs.q: Which central cause can lead to coma?
qs.ex: سبب مركزي: Stroke.

qs.q: What is the main presentation in the clinical diagnosis of coma?
qs.ex: أهم مظهر: نقص مستوى الوعي (DCL).

qs.q: Which of the following is commonly seen on a CT scan for coma diagnosis?
opts: Hemorrhage or edema in the brain
qs.ex: الـ CT بيبيّن نزيف أو ورم في المخ.

qs.q: Which laboratory test can suggest hepatic encephalopathy in a coma patient?
qs.ex: الأمونيا العالية: Hepatic encephalopathy.

qs.q: What could leukocytosis (elevated WBC count) indicate in a coma patient?
qs.ex: كرات الدم البيضا العالية: عدوى أو التهاب.

qs.q: What does a low T3 and T4 level in the thyroid profile suggest?
qs.ex: T3 وT4 واطيين: Myxedema coma.

qs.q: Elevated creatinine and urea levels in the kidney profile are indicative of:
qs.ex: الكرياتينين واليوريا العاليين: Uremic encephalopathy.

qs.q: Which condition may be suggested by elevated bilirubin levels in a coma patient?
qs.ex: البيليروبين العالي: مشكلة في الكبد.

qs.q: Which autoimmune profile finding suggests an increased risk of stroke?
qs.ex: الـ Anti-phospholipid antibodies بتزوّد خطر الجلطات.

qs.q: In coma management, what is the first step in conservative management?
qs.ex: أول خطوة: airway.

qs.q: Which of the following is a critical component of conservative management for bedridden coma patients?
qs.ex: العناية التنفسية أساسية للمريض الراقد.

qs.q: How should a bedridden coma patient be positioned to prevent complications?
opts: Position them in a sitting posture
Place them on their back permanently
qs.ex: نغيّر وضعه بانتظام علشان قرح الفراش.

qs.q: What is the recommended angle for the head of the bed in ventilated coma patients?
qs.ex: راس السرير 30–45°.

qs.q: What is the purpose of a "Ventilator Bundle" in coma management?
opts: To reduce the need for sedation
To prevent respiratory and circulatory complications
qs.ex: الـ Ventilator bundle بيمنع المضاعفات التنفسية والدورية.

qs.q: When is surgical decompression needed for coma patients?
opts: Only if the patient is in stable condition
When there is brain swelling, bleeding, or mass effect
qs.ex: الـ decompression لما يكون فيه ورم في المخ أو نزيف أو mass effect.

qs.q: What does a brain MRI with diffusion-weighted imaging primarily help diagnose in coma patients?
qs.ex: الـ DWI MRI بيشخّص الـ stroke بدري.

qs.q: What does a positive ANA test indicate in a coma patient?
qs.ex: الـ ANA الإيجابي: أمراض مناعة ذاتية زي الـ lupus.

qs.q: How can electrolyte imbalances contribute to coma?
qs.ex: اختلال الأملاح بيأثر على شغل المخ.

qs.q: What is the purpose of an echocardiogram in coma management?
qs.ex: الـ Echo بيقيّم القلب.

qs.q: In a coma patient, a CBC showing thrombocytosis or thrombocytopenia suggests:
qs.ex: زيادة أو نقص الصفائح: مشكلة نزيف أو التهاب.

qs.q: What does "ventilator bundle" refer to in the context of coma management?
opts: Measures for preventing respiratory and circulatory complications in ventilated patients
A medication plan for coma patients
A nutritional intervention for coma patients
qs.ex: إجراءات بتمنع المضاعفات عند مرضى الجهاز.

qs.q: In the management of coma patients, what is the role of oral care?
opts: To reduce the risk of infection
qs.ex: العناية بالفم بتقلّل العدوى (VAP).

qs.q: How does hypothyroidism contribute to coma?
opts: By causing myxedema coma due to low thyroid hormones
qs.ex: نقص الغدة الدرقية بيعمل myxedema coma.

qs.q: What is the significance of brain contusion in coma patients?
opts: It is a type of brain tumor
It results from traumatic brain injury and can lead to coma
It is an indication of systemic infection
qs.ex: الكدمة في المخ (contusion) من الإصابات وممكن تعمل غيبوبة.

qs.q: What condition is associated with elevated liver enzymes (AST, ALT) in coma patients?
qs.ex: إنزيمات الكبد العالية: Hepatic encephalopathy.

qs.q: What is the primary goal in the management of coma patients?
qs.ex: الهدف: نعالج السبب الأساسي.

qs.q: Which of the following is a key part of managing coma patients who are on mechanical ventilation?
opts: Keeping the patient sedated at all times
qs.ex: منع قرح الفراش جزء أساسي.

qs.q: A brain hemorrhage in a coma patient can lead to which of the following complications?
qs.ex: النزيف بيعمل ورم وضغط على المخ.

qs.q: Which of the following is a common sign of cardiogenic shock in ACS?
opts: Low blood pressure with signs of organ dysfunction
Lack of chest pain Acute Stroke:
qs.ex: الـ cardiogenic shock: ضغط واطي مع فشل في الأعضاء.

qs.q: What is the primary cause of ischemic stroke?
opts: Embolism from the left side of the heart or thrombus on the artery wall
Low oxygen levels in the brain
qs.ex: الـ ischemic stroke سببه embolus من الناحية الشمال للقلب، أو جلطة على جدار الشريان.

qs.q: Which of the following is a common symptom of Acute Stroke?
opts: Severe headache and disturbance of consciousness
Nausea and vomiting without any neurological deficits
qs.ex: حسب البنك: صداع شديد واضطراب في الوعي.

qs.q: Which imaging modality is used as the first step in diagnosing stroke to differentiate between ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke?
qs.ex: الـ CT أول خطوة علشان نفرّق بين الـ ischemic والـ hemorrhagic.

qs.q: What is the purpose of a Diffusion-Weighted Imaging (DWI) MRI in stroke diagnosis?
qs.ex: الـ DWI بيكشف الـ ischemia بدري.

qs.q: How does echocardiography contribute to stroke management?
opts: Identifies sources of embolism (e.g., LA appendage thrombus or LV smoke)
qs.ex: الـ Echo بيدوّر على مصدر الـ embolus في القلب.

qs.q: What is the significance of Duplex Ultrasound in stroke management?
opts: To assess for stenosis or blockages in carotid and basilar arteries
qs.ex: الـ Duplex بيشوف الضيق في الشرايين السباتية.

qs.q: What is the initial management approach for acute stroke patients?
opts: Keep the airway open and assess vital signs
qs.ex: أول حاجة: airway ونقيس العلامات الحيوية.

qs.q: Which medication is commonly used in medical management of ischemic stroke to prevent further clot formation?
qs.ex: الـ Aspirin أو الـ clopidogrel بيمنعوا جلطات جديدة.

qs.q: Within how many hours should thrombolytic therapy (e.g., tPA) be administered to ischemic stroke patients for optimal benefit?
qs.ex: الـ tPA خلال 3–4.5 ساعة من بداية الأعراض.

qs.q: What is the purpose of interventional thrombectomy in stroke management?
opts: To dissolve clots in smaller arteries
To remove a clot from a large blood vessel to restore blood flow
qs.ex: الـ Thrombectomy بيشيل الجلطة من شريان كبير.

qs.q: Which of the following procedures is used to treat brain aneurysms?
qs.ex: الـ Aneurysm بيتعالج بالـ coiling.

qs.q: What is the role of surgical decompression in stroke management?
opts: To remove a clot from an artery
To reduce brain swelling by removing part of the skull
To repair a damaged blood vessel
qs.ex: الـ Decompression بيشيل جزء من الجمجمة علشان يخفف الضغط.

qs.q: Which of the following is a characteristic of hemorrhagic stroke?
opts: Sudden severe headache and increase in intracranial pressure
No significant increase in intracranial pressure
Partial occlusion of a cerebral artery
qs.ex: الـ Hemorrhagic: صداع مفاجئ شديد وزيادة في ضغط المخ.

qs.q: What is a major complication associated with ischemic stroke that may require thrombolytic therapy?
qs.ex: حسب البنك: embolism من القلب.

qs.q: What is the significance of early administration of thrombolytic therapy in ischemic stroke?
opts: To restore blood flow and minimize brain damage
qs.ex: الـ thrombolytics بدري بترجّع الدم وبتقلّل الضرر.

qs.q: How does MRI with diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) aid in early detection of ischemic stroke?
opts: By identifying early tissue damage caused by reduced blood flow
By measuring oxygen levels in the blood
qs.ex: الـ DWI بيكشف ضرر الأنسجة بدري.

qs.q: What is the primary cause of ischemic stroke from the left side of the heart?
opts: Atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias causing embolism
qs.ex: الـ AF بيعمل جلطة في القلب الشمال وتطلع للمخ.

qs.q: Which of the following is a benefit of using anticoagulants such as aspirin or clopidogrel in ischemic stroke management?
qs.ex: مضادات الصفائح بتمنع جلطات جديدة.

qs.q: In which case would interventional thrombectomy be most appropriate for stroke patients?
opts: In patients with large vessel occlusion and ischemic stroke
qs.ex: الـ Thrombectomy مع انسداد شريان كبير.

qs.q: A patient with a TIA is at high risk for:
qs.ex: الـ TIA إنذار للـ stroke.

qs.q: Before giving thrombolytics for ischemic stroke, which finding must be reported?
qs.ex: قبل الـ thrombolytics لازم الضغط يبقى أقل من 185/110، فالضغط 195/110 لازم يتبلّغ.

qs.q: Select ALL signs of meningeal irritation.
qs.ex: علامات السحايا: تيبس الرقبة، وKernig، وBrudzinski، والحساسية من النور.

qs.q: A stroke patient with homonymous hemianopia should be taught to:
opts: Scan the environment by turning the head
qs.ex: يلف راسه ويمسح المكان بعينه.

qs.q: Before feeding a patient after stroke, the nurse first:
qs.ex: نشيك على الـ gag reflex.

qs.q: Myasthenia gravis is characterized by:
opts: Muscle weakness increasing with activity and improving with rest
qs.ex: الضعف بيزيد مع المجهود وبيتحسن مع الراحة.

qs.q: A nurse assessed a mechanically ventilated patient to determine the cause of low- pressure alarm but was unsuccessful. What should be the initial action to be taken?
qs.ex: لو مش عارف سبب الـ low-pressure alarm، افصل المريض عن الجهاز واعمله Manual ventilation بالـ ambu bag، لحد ما المشكلة تتحل.

qs.q: Which of the following laboratory values would most frequently be noted in a mechanically ventilated patient who has respiratory alkalosis?
qs.ex: الـ Respiratory alkalosis بتدخّل البوتاسيوم جوه الخلايا، فبيحصل Hypokalemia (K 3.0).

qs.q: The purpose of adding PEEP to positive pressure ventilation is to:
opts: Increase functional residual capacity and improve oxygenation
Determine synchrony with the ventilator or a need for sedatives
Increase FiO2 in an attempt to wean the patient and avoid O2 toxicity
Determine the ability to wean and reduce the risk of mediastinal emphysema
qs.ex: الـ PEEP بيزوّد الـ functional residual capacity، وبيخلي الـ alveoli مفتوحة، فالأكسجين بيتحسن.

qs.q: A 70 kg patient was intubated and connected to mechanical ventilation. The nurse can expect the initial tidal volume to be:
qs.ex: الـ Tidal volume من 6 لـ 8 mL/kg، يعني 70 × 6–8 = 420–560 mL.

qs.q: Which of the following criteria suggest the need for mechanical ventilation?
opts: Respiratory rate 40 br/min, pH 7.2, PaO2 55 mmHg, PaCO2 60 mmHg
Respiratory rate 30 br/min, pH 7.33, PaO2 66 mmHg, PaCO2 45 mmHg
Respiratory rate 29 br/min, pH 7.35, PaO2 70 mmHg, PaCO2 48 mmHg
Respiratory rate 25 br/min, pH 7.35, PaO2 75 mmHg, PaCO2 30 mmHg
qs.ex: دواعي الجهاز: تنفس سريع جداً، و pH 7.2، و PaO2 55، و PaCO2 60. يعني فيه hypoxemia و hypercapnia مع acidosis.

qs.q: To describe pressure support mechanical ventilation (PSV), the emergency nurse needs to identify that it:
opts: Keeps the alveoli open and prevents atelectasis
Allows preset pressure delivered during spontaneous ventilation
Delivers a preset ventilator rate and tidal volume to the patient
qs.ex: الـ PSV بيدي ضغط محدد يساعد كل نفس المريض بياخده لوحده.

qs.q: What is your first action when the low tidal volume alarm on a patient's mechanical ventilator keeps sounding?
qs.ex: الـ low tidal volume alarm غالباً سببه فصل أو تسريب، فأول حاجة نشيّك على وصلات الجهاز.

qs.q: The following are lung-protective ventilation strategies used in management of ARDS EXCEPT:
qs.ex: الـ lung-protective strategy معناها tidal volume قليل. يعني الـ high tidal volume هو الاستثناء.

qs.q: In mechanically ventilated patients, which of the following is a main cause for low pressure alarm?
opts: Presence of connection cut or hole
qs.ex: الـ Low pressure alarm سببه disconnection أو leak. أما الإفرازات والعض والـ fighting فدول بيعملوا HIGH pressure.

qs.q: In a mechanically ventilated patient, when there is a high-pressure alarm, SpO2 87%, and the patient struggles to sit up, the nurse's first action should be:
opts: Insert an oral airway to prevent biting on the endotracheal tube
Reassure the patient that the ventilator will do the work of breathing
Manually ventilate the patient while assessing possible reasons for the alarm
Increase fraction of inspired oxygen (FiO2) to 100% as preparation for suctioning
qs.ex: high-pressure alarm مع أكسجين واطي ومريض بيتخانق مع الجهاز: نعمله manual ventilation وإحنا بندور على السبب.

qs.q: Assessment of a patient on CPAP for weaning from mechanical ventilation revealed a respiratory rate of 32 br/min, O2 saturation of 85%, and use of accessory muscles. The possible decision is to:
qs.ex: لو التنفس 32، والأكسجين 85%، وبيستخدم accessory muscles، يبقى الـ weaning فشل، ونرجّعه على الـ full ventilation.

qs.q: Minute ventilation refers to the:
opts: Amount of air delivered with each breath
The percentage of air delivered with each breath
Total air volume moving in & out of the lung in one minute
Frequency of breaths delivered by the ventilator per minute
qs.ex: الـ Minute ventilation = كل الهوا اللي بيدخل ويطلع من الرئة في الدقيقة.

qs.q: To prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) in a patient with emphysema and respiratory failure, the most important nursing action is to:
opts: Maintain the head of bed at a 30- to 45-degree angle
Suction the airway when coarse crackles are audible
qs.ex: أهم حاجة تمنع الـ VAP إن راس السرير تبقى مرفوعة 30–45°.

qs.q: After extubation of a patient, which of the following findings would be reported immediately to the physician?
qs.ex: صوت crowing وقت الشهيق بعد شيل الأنبوبة = stridor (laryngeal edema)، ده بيتبلغ للدكتور فوراً.

qs.q: Assessment of a patient on CPAP for weaning from mechanical ventilation revealed a respiratory rate of 32 br/min, O2 saturation of 85%, and use of accessory muscles. The possible decision is to:
qs.ex: نفس السؤال اللي فات: علامات فشل الـ weaning، فنرجّع الـ full ventilation.

qs.q: Tidal volume is described as the:
opts: Amount of air delivered with each breath
The percentage of air delivered with each breath
The frequency of breaths delivered by the ventilator per minute
The total amount of volume moving in and out of the lung in one minute
qs.ex: الـ Tidal volume = كمية الهوا اللي بتدخل في كل نَفَس.

qs.q: Which of the following is NOT a goal of mechanical ventilation?
qs.ex: أهداف الجهاز: نحسّن الأكسجين ونطلّع الـ CO₂، ونريّح مجهود التنفس، ونحسّن ميكانيكية الرئة. الـ Preventing lung infection مش من أهدافه.

qs.q: The mode of ventilation which allows the patient to breathe spontaneously at his/her own respiratory rate and depth between the ventilator breaths is:
qs.ex: الـ SIMV بيدي أنفاس إجبارية، وبيسيب المريض يتنفس لوحده بينهم بالـ rate والعمق بتوعه.

qs.q: Which one of the following modes of mechanical ventilation "locks out" the patient's efforts to breathe?
qs.ex: الـ CMV بيدي كل الأنفاس، وبيلغي (locks out) أي محاولة من المريض إنه يتنفس.

qs.q: Which one of the following modes of ventilation "locks out" the patients' efforts to breathe?
qs.ex: نفس السؤال اللي فات: الـ Controlled Mandatory Ventilation هو اللي بيلغي محاولات المريض.

qs.q: Which of the following is a complication of keeping high PEEP?
qs.ex: الـ PEEP العالي بيزوّد الضغط في الصدر، فبيقلّل رجوع الدم للقلب ويعمل Hypotension.

qs.q: Which of the following statements describes tidal volume?
opts: The amount of air delivered with each breath
The total volume moving in and out of the lung in one minute
The percentage of air delivered with each breath
The frequency of breaths delivered by the ventilator per minute
qs.ex: الـ Tidal volume هو حجم الهوا اللي بيدخل مع كل نفس.

qs.q: Which of the following is an indication that an adult patient is being adequately ventilated?
qs.ex: لو الصدر بيعلى ويوطى، يبقى التهوية كويسة. والـ CRT أكتر من 3 ثواني معناه hypoperfusion. (إجابة مقترحة)

qs.q: To reduce the risk of Auto-PEEP, the nurse shall do which of the following?
qs.ex: علشان نقلل الـ auto-PEEP نشيل اللي سادد الـ airway (suction أو bronchodilator)، ونطوّل وقت الزفير. (إجابة مقترحة)

qs.q: Which one of the following is a risk of high PEEP?
qs.ex: الـ PEEP العالي بيعمل Hypotension.

qs.q: When a mechanically ventilated patient is required to receive 10 breaths/min and to spontaneously breathe in between the mechanical breaths at his own tidal volume, the physician selects which of the following modes?
qs.ex: الـ IMV بيدي عدد أنفاس ثابت (هنا 10)، والمريض بيتنفس لوحده بينهم بالـ tidal volume بتاعه. (إجابة مقترحة)

qs.q: Minute ventilation is equal to:
qs.ex: الـ Minute ventilation = Tidal volume × عدد مرات التنفس.

qs.q: Minute ventilation equals to:
qs.ex: الـ Minute ventilation = VT × RR. (إجابة مقترحة)

qs.q: The mode of pressure-targeted ventilation that provides positive pressure to decrease the workload of spontaneous breathing through the endotracheal tube is:
qs.ex: الـ Pressure support ventilation بيدي ضغط إيجابي يقلل مجهود التنفس التلقائي. (إجابة مقترحة)

qs.q: Auscultation of a patient's lungs after taping his endotracheal tube (that was not secured tightly) revealed that his breath sounds over the left lung fields are absent. The nurse suspects that:
opts: The endotracheal tube is in the right mainstem bronchus
The patient has a left pneumothorax
The patient has aspirated secretions during the procedure
The earpiece on the stethoscope is defective
qs.ex: مفيش صوت تنفس في الرئة الشمال بعد ما الأنبوبة اتحركت = الأنبوبة نزلت في الـ right mainstem bronchus. (إجابة مقترحة)

qs.q: Which of the following factors indicate that tracheotomy would be preferable to endotracheal intubation? (Select all
opts: The patient is unable to clear secretions
A long-term airway is probably necessary
The patient is at high risk for aspiration
An upper airway obstruction is impairing the patient's ventilation
qs.ex: الـ tracheostomy أحسن لو المريض مش قادر يطلّع إفرازاته، أو محتاج airway لمدة طويلة، أو معرض للـ aspiration، أو عنده انسداد في الـ upper airway. (إجابة مقترحة)

qs.q: Mrs. N (ARDS, intubated on AC mode). To check tube placement immediately after intubation, the nurse's responsibility is to:
opts: Arrange for ECG and chest radiograph
Check tube placement and cuff pressure
Auscultate bilateral breath sounds then fix the tube
Fix the tube and then percuss the chest
qs.ex: بعد الـ intubation على طول: نسمع الصوت التنفسي في الناحيتين علشان نتأكد إن الأنبوبة في القصبة ومش داخلة في ناحية واحدة، وبعدين نثبتها. إجابة مقترحة.

qs.q: During endotracheal suctioning the nurse applies suction intermittently:
opts: Only when the patient is coughing
Only during withdrawal of the catheter
qs.ex: الـ suction بيتعمل بشكل متقطع وإحنا بنسحب الـ catheter بس، مش وإحنا بندخّله، علشان مناخدش أكسجين ومنعورش الغشاء.

qs.q: While applying endotracheal suctioning, the recommended pressure setting is ...... mmHg.
qs.ex: ضغط الـ suction الموصى بيه للكبار حوالي 80–120 mmHg.

qs.q: During suctioning the nurse finds thick mucus difficult to remove. Which technique should be applied?
opts: Apply chest physiotherapy and nebulization before suctioning
qs.ex: لو الإفرازات تقيلة: chest physiotherapy ونيبولايزر قبل الـ suction علشان تسيح وتطلع بسهولة.
